svg.aria-label: Alert dialog dimensional drawing: source-backed confirmation surface, responsive media and action slots, exploded modal layers and dimension tables

g.text: SCALE 1:1 · OPTIONAL MEDIA · SLOT HEIGHTS SCHEMATIC
H1 / HD / H ARE CONTENT-DEPENDENT; THE SHEET SHOWS TWO DESCRIPTION LINES.

svg.text: PORTAL FIXED AT THE VIEWPORT OR CALLER CONTAINER.
EACH NESTED MODAL ADDS ITS OWN BACKDROP ABOVE THE PARENT.
CONTENT HAS NO AUTOMATIC CLOSE CONTROL.
FOOTER ARROWS LOOP; TAB VISITS EACH CONTROL.
PENDING ACTION LOCKS DISMISSAL AND PEERS.
RESOLUTION CLOSES; REJECTION RETAINS THE FRAME.
MEDIA: BESIDE TEXT AT BP; ABOVE BELOW BP.
PHONE ACTION ORDER IS REVERSED IN THE DOM.
BODY DIRECTLY IN CONTENT SCROLLS ALONE.
WITHOUT BODY, THE CONTENT LAYOUT SCROLLS.
ALL WIDTHS MARKED HUG ARE CALLER-DEFINED.
ROOT 16 PX; ONE PRODUCTION DEMO AUDITED.
NOMINAL EXTENTS · NO HARD BLUR CUTOFF
E1 / E2 / E3 TAKE MAXIMUM OF BOTH LAYERS.
BORDER B IS REAL; SHADOW ADDS NO LAYOUT SIZE.
PENDING: I2 CENTERED; HIDDEN CHILDREN RETAIN HUG WIDTH.
LOADER: LOCAL / PROVIDER / FALLBACK. PEERS DISABLED, STILL FOCUSABLE.
IDLE LABEL PAD: S6 · OPTIONAL ICON GAP: S7 · FRAME: ARIA-BUSY.
MEDIA / TEXT HUG; TRACK LIMITS WRAPPING.
SOURCE: ALERT-DIALOG MODULES · DIALOG SHARED / VARIANTS
BUTTON VARIANTS · GLOBALS.CSS · LIVE DESKTOP / PHONE AUDIT
